EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Status Monitor
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time and Attendance Support. You can set up an alternate Status Monitor by following the steps below:
Navigate to System Setup > Status Monitor Setup
Click the ADD button at the bottom of the page
Name / Description:
These can be set to whatever value you desire; the Name will display when selecting which monitor you wish to view in the Daily Procedures > Status Monitor page.
Automatically filter employee list for each supervisor:
Set to No to show all employee results
Set Yes to filter to each viewer's direct reports
Monitor Columns to Display:
Select the column you wish to view from the Add Column drop-down menu and click the blue plus (+) button to the right of that menu
Repeat that step until all desired columns are listed below
You can adjust the order (sequence) of the columns, and other settings as desired
Monitor Filters:
Select ONE filter type to utilize and move the desired items from the Available box on the right to the Assigned box on the left
We typically recommend NOT filtering by Employee here, as new employees would need to be added manually each time someone is hired. Rather, utilizing a filter that would be assigned to all employees (like a pay group), will allow new employees to be pulled into the Status Monitor automatically.
Please let us know if you have any questions, and we would be happy to help.
Thank you,
